title: Tenant Ops Inspector — compact incident + upgrade cards for private clusters
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Ops and tenant engineers managing Private/VPC clusters need a single glanceable surface in the Console that combines cluster/network health, active upgrades, and recent incidents with clear next actions. Current status pages and cluster lists are either too sparse (no context) or too verbose (hard to scan during paging).

Goal: Design a compact, reflowing set of 'Tenant Ops Inspector' cards that can live on the Private Cluster Overview and in the Incident Playbook view. Each card surface should a) show the minimal high-signal telemetry (latency P95, node loss, KV cache hit rate, last control-plane reconcile), b) surface ongoing rollouts/upgrades with per-tenant canary state and rollback affordances, and c) include cost delta and estimated burn for the last 24h. Cards must be actionable (link to runbooks, trigger safe-mode rollback, open a support ticket) and accessible.

Success metrics: reduce mean time-to-detect (MTTD) for tenant-impacting events by 25% in pilot team; reduce click-path from incident open to rollback or remediation by 40%; positive qualitative feedback from two SRE and two customer success participants in usability sessions.

User stories:
- As an on-call SRE, I want to scan a tenant row and immediately see if an ongoing private upgrade is in canary, degraded, or rolled back, so I can decide whether to pause rollout.
- As a platform PM, I want to quickly compare cost delta across tenants post-upgrade to catch regressions.
- As a customer success engineer, I want direct links from card to tenant audit logs and a prefilled support template so I can open customer issues faster.

Design constraints and notes:
- Cards must condense to 1–2 lines in compact list, expand to show timeline and actions on hover or tap (mobile friendly).
- Avoid duplicating full network topology; show a micro-graph (3-point sparkline) and a link to the cluster network canvas.
- Respect private deployment telemetry limits: fall back to last-known state if live metrics are limited.
- Must work in the Console’s existing grid and theming tokens.

Acceptance criteria:
- Figma prototype with compact list + expanded detail modal for at least three tenant states (healthy, degraded during upgrade, network-partition).
- Interaction spec for rollback/canary controls and their guarded confirmations.
- Accessibility checklist completed (contrast, keyboard focus, ARIA labels for card actions).
- Hand-off-ready annotations and dataset mapping for ENG ingestion (telemetry fields: cluster_id, tenant_id, upgrade_state, p95_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate, cost_delta_24h).
